info.description: Source-contract discovery for existing Java 25 controllers. M27 decedent/custody remains governed by the independent synqoria-m27-mortuary-v1.yaml. No hospital release or supplier/provider delivery certification. Typed DTO fields mirror the existing Java records. Nullable Java reference fields are not declared universally required; workflow validators remain authoritative.
